bio.text: Richard Pan is the Democratic candidate for California's 6th Congressional District in 2026.
He served in the California State Assembly from 2010 to 2014 and in the State Senate, representing District 6, from December 2014 to December 2022, including as chair of the Senate Health Committee.

He holds a B.S. from Johns Hopkins University, a master's in public health from Harvard University and an M.D. from the University of Pittsburgh, and has worked as a physician at UC Davis Children's Hospital and as an associate professor of pediatrics at UC Davis.
